description: Return the consolidated, deduped people who reacted to or commented on a SET of posts — one tracked profile's posts (profile_id) or a post collection (collection_id). Fetches only posts not synced within freshness_days, walks up to max_pages_per_post pages (100 people/page) of reactions and of comments per post, includes comment replies, and enriches (title/company via a profile lookup) only never-seen people, up to max_enrich. Costs 1 credit per page fetched (a page is up to 100 people; a post with under 100 reactions and under 100 comments = 2 credits; the most a post can cost is 2 × max_pages_per_post) + 3 per person enriched; cached posts and cached pages are free. The balance must cover the worst case (posts × 2 × max_pages_per_post + max_enrich × 3) before anything runs; you are charged only for pages actually fetched. Per-post reactions_fetched / reactions_total / comments_total / truncated tell you when a post had more engagers than were fetched.

collection_id.description: post_collections.id — engagers across this collection's posts

force.description: Re-sync posts even if within the freshness window

freshness_days.description: Skip posts whose engagers were synced within this many days

max_enrich.description: Max never-seen engagers to enrich via /linkedin/profile (0-100, default 0)

max_pages_per_post.description: Max pages (100 people each) to walk per endpoint per post (1-20, default 10). Each page costs 1 credit.

max_posts.description: Max posts to sync this call (1-100)

profile_id.description: Tracked profile id — engagers across this profile's stored posts

name: get_post_set_engagers
title: Get Post-Set Engagers
